page_title: AUG 1-0 WOL | Augsburg v Wolfsburg 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The referee shows a yellow card to Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+6' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+6' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul. Martin Petersen had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+4' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) attempts to find Patrick Wimmer, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+3' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
90+1' Half-chance! Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Total attempts – 9:10.
87' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) replacing Marius Wolf.
87' Substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice is replaced by Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
86' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
86' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Mattias Svanberg will be replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
84' Here's the change. Kilian Fischer leaves the pitch and Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
84' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
83' There's an opportunity for Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
82' The resulting corner from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is cleared by the defence.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Essende (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Phillip Tietz can be given a rest.
79' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
77' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
73' Augsburg are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
71' Here comes a substitution. Fredrik Jensen is given a rest as he is replaced by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg).
70' A precise first-time shot by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
70' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes it short.
67' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Bence Dardai and he is replaced by Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg).
65' It is time for a substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is on for Jonas Wind.
64' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
64' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
63' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

62' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
61' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Martin Petersen signals.
53' 1 - 0 Goal! Dimitrios Giannoulis slips in Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) for a one-on-one with the keeper, and he simply dinks the ball over him into the net.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Augsburg.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
49' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
44' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Kamil Grabara.
42' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Martin Petersen interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
37' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.

34' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the left post, but Kamil Grabara makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
33' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
32' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
32' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) makes a strong challenge and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
30' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
30' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
28' 3:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
26' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
25' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
24' Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul after Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) hacks down one of his opponents.
22' Half-chance! Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.
21' Flag up against Phillip Tietz (Augsburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
20' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Augsburg win a free kick.
18' Fouls committed – 2:0.
16' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 38:62.
14' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
13' The Wolfsburg players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
10' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
6' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
4' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
1' Augsburg are ruled offside.
1' The match has just started.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Martin Petersen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
